{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# First, ensure sample_seq is numeric (it is, but just to be safe)
data['sample_seq'] = pd.to_numeric(data['sample_seq'], errors='coerce')

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to prepare for deduplication
data_sorted = data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Drop duplicates, keeping the first (highest sample_seq) row for each patient
data_dedup = data_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 2: Check the number of unique sites
data_dedup['site'].unique()"}
